propositions: Durable bridge status must replace duplicate pass-record producers with one process-finalizer writer that records minimal JSON to refs/reconciler/last-pass before releasing refs/reconciler/lock using three-attempt bounded CAS with 100/200ms backoff.

Canonical rebar bridge status and hidden rebar bridge-status aliases must expose identical read-only snapshots with total precedence PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY, returning specific exit codes (0 for HEALTHY/PAUSED, 1 for STALE/FOREIGN/NEVER_RUN/FAILED/CRASHED) and never invoking steal() or sleeping for lease.

Local and CI identity cannot collide: explicit REBAR_ENV_ID wins; otherwise writer and status derive stable local:<repo-env-id> from .env-id; missing/empty/unreadable .env-id is a hard configuration error; inbound LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID and workflow reconciler identity remain unchanged.

Canary must transition from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable status, fetching refs/reconciler/*, performing two read-only snapshots to detect stalled live-lock fence (CRASHED verdict), waiting observed lease_secs (default 120, reject >480s), and making no heartbeat API query on the canonical path while preserving explicit github-api rollback for one release.

Rich detail is one rolling .bridge_state/last-pass.json file overwritten by normal tickets-branch commit, safely degrading to diagnostic-only facts when absent or mismatched; status reads and matches detail only when pass and environment ids align with the authoritative ref.

All duplicate producers and dead baseline symbols must be removed after semantic and string reference sweeps; ADR 0094 must document extension of ADR 0031 live-fence/lease-blob/shared CAS-classifier prior art; byte-exact bridge help and CLI reference must be regenerated; and numbering marker/index must follow current convention with collision reallocation rule.
